entry_points.text: Mount copies type/device/opts from user, invokes core mount, frees reverse, returns status.
Fs-mount validates flags/caps, checks root/phase, refuses revealing/restricted/missing, creates mount installing as ns or unmount-on-close, warns on mandlock, cleans to picked state.
Move-mount checks perm/flags, resolves target/source via descriptor or filename, applies security then prop-change or move.
Pivot-root resolves both paths with follow/directory then delegates to path pivot.
Setattr entry filters lookup bits, derives automount/follow/recursion, delegates to prepared change.
Open-tree installs descriptor via internal opener with cloexec; with-attrs validates size/pointer, opens, applies change and publishes.
Statmount accepts only by-file bit, denies foreign ns, holds ns shared around core query.
Listmount accepts only reverse bit, caps count at one million, denies foreign ns, holds ns shared.

exports.text: Expose embedded ns handle; RCU iterator skips no-admin/unrefable entries returning first held neighbor; alloc enforces per-user limit, zeroes, inits identity/generation/one passive/empty tree/queues/user-count with unwind; release unmounts whole tree on last ref; ns holds common/user/root/count/tree/queue/refs/anon/sequence/accounting.

Detached copy snapshots origin, duplicates subtree with recursion and enrolls; new-ns pins/duplicates root handling foreign/locked/single-vs-tree then publishes; copy shares or clones redirecting root/cwd; detached open swaps to fresh root unmount-on-close; nsfs opener gives read-only path; subtree mount returns held dentry.

Collect ref-held terminated array growing from prealloc, validating start/beneath; release drops refs freeing only non-prealloc; private clone validates source/admin/locks cloning private internal; dir mount delegates; option/string copy bounded with fallback distinguishing fault; expiry appends read-guarded; mounts hold handle/ns/links/prop/expiry/locks.

Exact-copy holder auto-unlocks; tree opener validates/resolves/dispatches to ns/detached/plain; ns-file test compares ops; prop encodes shared/slave/unbindable else private; dominating-id scans masters/peers for reachable else zero; path renders relative with mangle; chroot/membership under reader guard; unmount RCU-waits, array expedited.

hazards.text: Cross-dossier helpers for errors, cleanup, creds, caps, lists, seqlocks, atomics, barriers, rwonce, strings, user copy, security, namespaces, rcu, refcounts, tasks, alloc, overflow, dev numbers, warnings owned elsewhere; no behavior specified.

invariants.text: Subtree test checks child mountpoint at/beneath dentry; beneath selects parent of topmost overmount else follow stack to top/root; peer-group change needs exclusive ns, root/single-fs/narrowed/lock-free/private-vs-shared then links slave or joins shared.

Attr mapping preserves ro/suid/dev/exec/diratime/symfollow with strict as no-atime-bits rejecting others; report prefers noatime over relatime over strict plus idmap flag; idmapped iff mapping differs from null; build validates bits/atime-clear, clears then installs mode; idmap build retains non-initial admin ns or installs null.

Idmap allowed when none requested else checks reuse/replacement/support/admin/anon; flags clear-then-set, writers kept only if not newly ro and no idmap; intake enforces size/perm/copy and no-op; application needs mounted path, allocates idmap, locks ns for prop with validation/prealloc then hash for prepare/commit.

SB/mount reports set masks with dev/ids/attr/prop/peer-master zero-master-if-non-slave; prop via internal flags; peer scan plus id validation feed propagate-from; root/point render with retry/unescape/skip; flag reads ordered, unmounted parent reads use reader guard.

By-fd uses file mount/ns clearing point/ns-id when detached else by-id validates ns/id; takes root enforcing reachability/admin and security; caches idmap, fills basics then strings in order then ns-id/mask; flags/idmap may skew via single-copy; string/opts/array helpers dispatch, retry on overflow, strip/split/decode/count.

Type/subtype/source report names preferring devname hook; uid/gid render counts raising mask when valid idmap; result copy places payload after header with min header, total size, aborting fault on either copy failure.

List resolves root/parent under ns shared enforcing reachability/security, picks start per direction, walks tree collecting reachable to capacity skipping parent; iterator steps tree or null; root duplicates current or picks child; ns prefers id else proc-file else current; request validates sizes/modes/ids.

Query prep validates range, stores mask/buf, allocs scratch only for string bits rejecting header-only; retry doubles on transient overflow with guards; list prep accepts zero/above-offset storing cursor/capacity/ids/ns/parent with root/array/ns cleanup.

Mount-ns type registers mount name with get/put/install/owner; get samples task proxy held with ref, put drops, owner returns user ns; sysctl exposes mount-max uint owner-write/world-read min-one registered under fs.

locks.text: Pinning samples under read guard then takes inode plus ns with revalidation refusing bad/stale/beneath, dropping temp refs safely via still-mounted pin; unlock releases inode, unpins under sequence, releases ns; exact lock pins then duplicates/retains; overmount uses RCU then exclusive on change; order inode-ns-writer with reader nested.

state_machines.text: Expiry under ns plus writer moves still-mounted second-mark non-busy incl propagation to graveyard then drains rechecking busyness, returning busy or touching generation and unmounting sync with propagation; mark one-shot cleared by release needing two observations.

Attr walk prepares validating locked/idmap and holding writers with full unwind on failure, then commits installing idmap/flags/propagation, releasing holds, marking ns touched, stopping after first when non-recursive; flags ordered writes, idmap release/acquire.
Install checks admin/chroot, rejects anon/shared, swaps ref, looks up slash rolling back on failure else releases old and updates home/root.

structs.text: Query scratch holds user buf/size, target mount/idmap, mask, root, seq file ending with stats ending in flex array so last; list holds last/parent/array/cap/ns/root; initial ns inits common/user-one/passive/empty/queue; nsfs keeps global mount and root.

Tree walk low bits select beneath/propagation; ns copy low bits select recursive/fresh-single; creation allows ro/suid/dev/exec/atime/nodiratime/nosymfollow; setattr adds idmap; propagation one of unbindable/private/slave/shared.

Supported unions basic-sb/mount/propagate/root/point/type/ns-id/opts/subtype/source/opt-arrays/supported/uidmap/gidmap warning if outside; string class of root/point/type/opts/subtype/source/arrays/maps triggers scratch.
